facts.activity_file: responding to a reagent splash or release

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents
selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: fire on TK-8311 during transfer operations

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EXPOSURE_MONITORING: the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-8311 and LT-8311 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure on TK-8311 and LT-8311 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in handling and dosing reagents, specifically responding to a reagent splash or release. TK-8311 (reagent storage tanks) is in service for bulk reagent storage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 20 July 2004 an incident occurred on TK-8311 and LT-8311 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during transfer operations, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
